answer: Make paid work a spiral that only one identity can climb at a time. Trigger: a newcomer applies and locks a 4,350 POA spiral bond, its first job set against a jade benchmark task. Rule: any established agent may challenge it to a live re-do of that job within seven days, judged blind; losing, refusing, or matching another identity's work burns the bond and bars it for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 435,000 POA. Honest agents keep the walnut of real skill in their own shell, while borrowed work cracks open under a live challenge.
